note: Stage 2 (2026-10-18, [У]): split by the statement audit (local/research/statement_audit/AUDIT.md). Applied after stage 1 (plan.json) and the point overrides. Every sub-direction keeps its parent's orientation, so a bill keeps its parent sign; Jev only chooses the sub-direction (pipeline/jev_split.py --stage2).

269a.plus_en: Makes abortion easier to obtain (e.g. without a termination committee, wider grounds, funding).

269b.plus_en: Widens access to surrogacy, egg or sperm donation, IVF, fertility preservation or posthumous sperm use, or to more groups of people.

92a.plus_en: Limits or abolishes the death penalty for terrorists.
92a.minus_en: Introduces or eases the death penalty for terrorists.

92b.name_ru: права и условия заключённых по безопасности
92b.name_en: Rights and conditions of security prisoners
92b.plus_en: Gives prisoners jailed for terrorism or security offences more rights or milder conditions (visits, phone, studies, early release).
92b.minus_en: Gives them fewer rights or harsher conditions.

92c.name_ru: права и условия обычных заключённых и задержанных
92c.name_en: Rights and conditions of ordinary prisoners and detainees
92c.plus_en: Gives criminal prisoners and detainees more rights or milder conditions (rehabilitation, health care, limits on shackling, living space).
92c.minus_en: Gives them fewer rights or harsher conditions.

255a.name_en: Funding of schools that do not teach the core curriculum
255a.plus_en: Gives schools that do not teach core subjects (math, English) more state funding or fewer conditions.
255a.minus_en: Cuts their funding or makes it conditional on teaching core subjects.

255b.name_en: Funding of schools whose teaching is hostile to the state
255b.plus_en: Keeps or increases funding of schools regardless of content such as incitement or calls to refuse military service.
255b.minus_en: Cuts funding of schools that teach such content.

255c.name_en: Funding of schools that discriminate in admission
255c.plus_en: Keeps or increases funding of schools regardless of how they admit students.
255c.minus_en: Cuts funding of schools that reject students by ethnic origin or similar grounds.

151a.plus_en: Gives rabbinical or other religious courts more powers (e.g. arbitration in civil and money disputes).

151b.name_ru: еврейские религиозные правила в государственных учреждениях
151b.name_en: Jewish religious rules in public institutions
151b.plus_en: Makes hospitals, army bases, state bodies or public places follow more Jewish religious rules (kashrut, no leavened bread on Passover, Shabbat).
151b.minus_en: Makes them follow fewer such rules.

151c.name_ru: раздельность мужчин и женщин в публичных местах
151c.plus_en: Allows or expands separation of men and women in state and municipal services, events, studies or transport.

151d.plus_en: Gives Orthodox religious law more control over who is registered or recognised as Jewish (registry, conversion).
151d.minus_en: Gives it less control; non-Orthodox conversion or civil criteria count more.

356a.plus_en: Allows or expands public transport on Shabbat and holidays.

356b.plus_en: Gives more money or benefits to public transport (fare discounts, free travel, more lines and services).

169a.plus_en: Increases state funding, planning, regularisation, services or security for settlements in Judea and Samaria.

169b.name_en: Israeli sovereignty in Judea and Samaria
169b.plus_en: Applies Israeli law or sovereignty to Judea and Samaria or parts of it.

90a.name_en: Procedural rights of suspects and defendants
90a.plus_en: Gives suspects and defendants more safeguards in arrest, questioning, trial and appeal (lawyer, recording, disclosure).

90b.name_en: Leniency of punishment for terror offences
90b.plus_en: Makes punishment of terror offenders milder or keeps more rights for them.
90b.minus_en: Makes punishment harsher (death penalty, loss of citizenship or residency, longer sentences).

130a.name_ru: льготы гражданам в войну и чрезвычайное положение
130a.name_en: Relief for citizens in wartime and emergencies
130a.plus_en: Gives or extends relief tied to war or emergency: tax breaks, grants, payment delays for reservists, evacuees and businesses.

130b.plus_en: Extends emergency legal powers or makes them last longer.

101b1.name_en: Guardianship of parents accused of violence
101b1.plus_en: Keeps or eases guardianship and custody of parents charged with or convicted of violence in the family.
101b1.minus_en: Lets the state remove or restrict their guardianship.

101b2.name_ru: доступ родителей к наблюдению за детьми
101b2.name_en: Parents' monitoring of children in care
101b2.plus_en: Gives parents more access to monitoring of their children (e.g. daycare camera footage).

66a.name_ru: судебный контроль над законами и правительством
66a.name_en: Judicial review of laws and government
66a.plus_en: Courts review and can strike down more laws and government decisions.
66a.minus_en: Courts review less; the Knesset can override or shield laws from review.

66b.plus_en: Gives judges more discretion in sentencing.
66b.minus_en: Fixes minimum or mandatory punishments, limiting judges' discretion.
